Phone control details: Remote Control: drive a local session from Claude iOS/Android app or claude.ai/code (QR pairing). Server mode hosts up to 32 concurrent sessions; new sessions can be started from the phone. Dispatch can also send tasks from phone to Desktop.
Remote machine details: Desktop app runs sessions locally, over SSH, in WSL, or in Anthropic cloud; Team/Enterprise can use self-hosted cloud environments. Remote Control works from any machine running `claude` (run inside tmux over SSH).
Multi-agent details: Parallel sessions in Desktop (split view, per-session git worktrees); subagents; experimental Agent Teams (lead + teammates in worktrees that message each other); RC server mode can spawn a worktree per session.
Keeps running when laptop sleeps?: Cloud sessions: yes. Remote Control: host must stay on.
Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux (beta); iOS, Android, web
Pricing: Pro / Max / Team / Enterprise (Remote Control not available with API keys)
Status / notes: Remote Control launched Feb 2026 (research preview), now on all paid plans.
